text:
Which statement about alloys is correct?
A
Alloys are pure metal elements.
B
At least two or more metals react together to make alloys.
C
Alloys can be harder and stronger than a pure metal.
D
Steel is not an alloy because it can contain the non-metal carbon.

options.label: B
options.text: At least two or more metals react together to make alloys.

options.label: C
options.text: Alloys can be harder and stronger than a pure metal.

options.label: D
options.text: Steel is not an alloy because it can contain the non-metal carbon.
